sections.heading: ME Coordinator (Civil-Environmental Engineering).
sections.content: Master’s degree in Civil Environmental Engineering program at APCOER, Pune encourages research in emerging areas like green and smart technologies, smart infrastructure and eco-friendly materials, remote sensing technology and contributing in interdisciplinary innovations in the field of science and technology for industrial and societal benefits. It provides advanced understanding and skills in managing environmental challenges related to civil and environmental engineering, including pollution control, waste management, water resources, and sustainable designs and developments. The students are equipped to tackle pressing local and global issues like climate change, resource depletion and environmental degradation by applying engineering principles to create sustainable and effective solutions. ME-Civil Environmental Engineering, including environmental impact assessment, sustainable development and advanced water treatment technologies with interdisciplinary innovations and applications. The well equipped modern laboratories and research facilities enables our students to engage in hands-on learning and innovative research and development collaborative or individual activities. The students from this post graduate course at APCOER secured several prizes at national and international events. APCOER operates under the mentorship of COEP Technological University, Pune, and serves as a Remote Center for the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Bombay. Additionally, it hosts an NPTEL Swayam Local Chapter affiliated with IIT Madras.

### ME Coordinator (Civil-Environmental Engineering).
Master’s degree in Civil Environmental Engineering program at APCOER, Pune encourages research in emerging areas like green and smart technologies, smart infrastructure and eco-friendly materials, remote sensing technology and contributing in interdisciplinary innovations in the field of science and technology for industrial and societal benefits. It provides advanced understanding and skills in managing environmental challenges related to civil and environmental engineering, including pollution control, waste management, water resources, and sustainable designs and developments. The students are equipped to tackle pressing local and global issues like climate change, resource depletion and environmental degradation by applying engineering principles to create sustainable and effective solutions. ME-Civil Environmental Engineering, including environmental impact assessment, sustainable development and advanced water treatment technologies with interdisciplinary innovations and applications. The well equipped modern laboratories and research facilities enables our students to engage in hands-on learning and innovative research and development collaborative or individual activities. The students from this post graduate course at APCOER secured several prizes at national and international events. APCOER operates under the mentorship of COEP Technological University, Pune, and serves as a Remote Center for the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Bombay. Additionally, it hosts an NPTEL Swayam Local Chapter affiliated with IIT Madras.
